84转业务外包PR/PO下单及跟进流程交接说明: Handover Notes for the 84-to-Business-Outsourcing PR/PO Ordering and Follow-up Process
背景、当前问题、需要对方做什么、希望何时完成。: Background, current issue, required action, and expected completion date.
不知道对应采购是谁时，联系傅强。: If you do not know the relevant procurement contact, contact Fu Qiang.
采购联系人、合同、供应商框架、BPA: Procurement contact, contract, supplier framework agreement, BPA
二、四项目催办流程: II. Follow-up Process for the Four Projects
各项目SPM确认项目编码、合同编号、Sub-Project Code、Reque: Each project's SPM confirms the project code, contract number, Sub-Project Code, Requester, and Approver.
合同、供应商框架、BPA：找采购。: For contracts, supplier framework agreements, and BPAs, contact Procurement.
请在HTML源码底部的 PR_SAMPLE_IMAGE_BASE64 变量中粘贴: Paste the Base64 content into the PR_SAMPLE_IMAGE_BASE64 variable at the bottom of the HTML source.
确定四项目Cost Share，合计100%: Confirm the Cost Share for the four projects, totaling 100%.
确认PO创建、审批和下发时间；PO下发后人员才能正式进场。: Confirm the PO creation, approval, and issuance dates. Personnel can formally start only after the PO is issued.
三、PR表格重点字段: III. Key Fields in the PR Form
审批链或系统状态：找Irfan。: For the approval chain or system status, contact Irfan.
适用于下一位人员涉及 TE、ET、VDF、ORG 四个项目的PR/PO办理与跟进: Applicable to PR/PO processing and follow-up for the next person working across the TE, ET, VDF, and ORG projects.
收集人员、项目、合同、BPA、Requester、Approver等信息。: Collect personnel, project, contract, BPA, Requester, Approver, and other information.
收集四个项目资料，并由SPM提前沟通Requester与Approver: Collect information for all four projects, and have each SPM communicate with the Requester and Approver in advance.
四个项目的Requester和Approver均已在下PR前提前沟通。: The Requester and Approver for all four projects have been contacted before the PR is submitted.
四个项目Cost Share合计为100%。: The Cost Share for the four projects totals 100%.
四条审批路径全部完成: All four approval paths are complete.
提交PR并跟进审批: Submit the PR and follow up on approval.
图片通过HTML源码中的Base64变量加载。: The image is loaded through a Base64 variable in the HTML source.
系统操作或下单支持：找马哲军，并提前提供完整信息。: For system operations or ordering support, contact Ma Zhejun and provide complete information in advance.
项目背景、人员安排：找SPM或业务主管。: For project background and personnel arrangements, contact the SPM or business manager.
协助系统操作和下单；需要提前提供清晰、完整的信息。业务背景、项目分摊等需由业务侧: Assist with system operations and ordering. Clear and complete information must be provided in advance. The business team must confirm the business context, project allocation, and other details.
需要联系采购（CEG）刷新BPA，并获取新的BPA信息。: Contact Procurement (CEG) to refresh the BPA and obtain the new BPA information.
月底才提交PR风险很高，可能还未完成下单，BPA就已失效。建议提前检查有效期并尽: Submitting the PR only at month-end is high risk. The BPA may expire before the order is completed. Check the expiration date and start the process as early as possible.
重点提醒：BPA通常会在每月1日凌晨过期。: Key reminder: BPAs typically expire at midnight on the first day of each month.
准备下一位人员PR: Prepare the PR for the next person
BPA一旦过期，系统无法继续下单。: Once a BPA expires, the system cannot continue processing the order.
ET SPM确认资料并提前沟通Requester、Approver: The ET SPM confirms the information and communicates with the Requester and Approver in advance.
Irfan协助下发PR和提供审批链；PR提交后，分别联系四个项目SPM，由SPM: Irfan assists with issuing the PR and providing the approval chain. After the PR is submitted, contact the SPM for each of the four projects to follow up with their respective Approver.
ORG SPM确认资料并提前沟通Requester、Approver: The ORG SPM confirms the information and communicates with the Requester and Approver in advance.
